review_scope: Source identity, directly accessible scientific content, source-role separation and obstacles to reproducible source-lock proofs

sources.work: Song, I.; Park, C.; Choi, H. C. Synthesis and properties of molybdenum disulphide: from bulk to atomic layers.
sources.role: peer-reviewed secondary review; no new independent primary determination

verified_locations.claim: Bulk MoS2 comprises S–Mo–S structural layers; review distinguishes polytypes 1T, 2H and 3R by coordination and stacking
For bulk 2H-MoS2 the review summarizes hexagonal space group P 6_3/mmc, stacking AbA BaB and lattice parameters a = 3.15 Å, c = 12.30 Å
verified_locations.qualifier: Review-reported approximate values from referenced study (ref. 35), not a novel experiment by Song et al.

verified_locations.claim: 2H and 3R share trigonal-prismatic Mo coordination yet differ in stacking; 1T has octahedral coordination

sources.recovery_assessment: Scientific passage and Table 1 content were checked on publisher-hosted open HTML. Does not meet L2 raw-capture hashing or L3 later-date authenticated re-fetch.

sources.work: Dickinson, R. G.; Pauling, L. The Crystal Structure of Molybdenite.
sources.publisher: American Chemical Society / Caltech archival reproduction
sources.publication: Journal of the American Chemical Society 1923, volume 45, issue 6, pages 1466–1471
sources.access: publisher_bibliographic_page_paywalled; Caltech-hosted 1925 Pauling PhD thesis contains a scanned reprint of the Dickinson–Pauling 1923 article
sources.role: originating 1923 primary study; Caltech reprint is another manifestation of the SAME work, not a third independent experiment

verified_locations.section: Caltech PDF opening pages, reproduced 1923 article, 'The Unit of Structure'
verified_locations.claim: Original historical article identifies molybdenite as MoS2 and discusses a hexagonal structural unit with c-axis repeat approximately 12.30 Å and two MoS2 formula units per unit cell
verified_locations.qualifier: Textual PDF extract only; page-image screenshot service did not return a preview. Not a completed visual audit or raw file capture.

sources.recovery_assessment: A free institutional archival version exists, avoiding mandatory purchase for review. The page cannot be treated as hash-captured or proof of a fresh original article scan until independently downloaded, visually inspected and hashed.

sources.work: Schönfeld, B.; Huang, J. J.; Moss, S. C. Anisotropic mean-square displacements (MSD) in single-crystals of 2H- and 3R-MoS2.
sources.publication: Acta Crystallographica Section B 1983, volume 39, pages 404–407
sources.access: bibliographic issue contents accessible; full publisher article subject to subscription
sources.role: 1983 primary crystallographic publication; identical originating work to COD 9007660, not additional independent evidence

verified_locations.claim: Confirms author names, 1983 issue, 2H and 3R subject and bibliographic DOI; does not expose all crystallographic values from the paper

sources.recovery_assessment: Bibliographic identity independently corroborated; scientific excerpt remains prior uploaded scope only. No L2 or L3 passed.

sources.work: J. J. Huang, M.S. thesis, University of Houston (1981)
sources.access: existing project excerpt says thesis was uploaded; no independently accessible institutional thesis full-text URL established in this review
sources.role: academic supporting source; related researcher lineage to 1983 Schönfeld/Huang/Moss work, not independent primary corroboration
sources.recovery_assessment: L2/L3/L4 remain pending. Do not present 1981 thesis as peer reviewed or count it separately from the 1983 originating work.

scientific_conclusions: MoS2 formula is not enough to infer 1T/2H/3R structure.
For bulk 2H, the review reports P 6_3/mmc and approximate a 3.15 Å, c 12.30 Å; individual primary determinations from COD must remain differentiated.
c-axis unit-cell repetition is not the same as the thickness of an isolated S–Mo–S sandwich.
RSC review, a journal excerpt, its COD record and a researcher's thesis may be manifestations of related evidence and must not be counted as independent experiments solely because URLs differ.
next_capture_requirements: Retrieve exact RSC publisher HTML bytes into the repository's authenticated capture pipeline, record HTTP status, final URL, retrieval timestamp, SHA-256 and source-use fields, then perform a later independent re-fetch for L3.
Retrieve Caltech-hosted archival reprint if permitted, inspect visually and hash exact bytes; cite 1923 original work and the repository manifestation separately without double counting.
Maintain ACTA 1983 excerpt-scoped evidence and the existing COD 9007660 original-lineage identity; no invented paid-article access.
Find an authoritative, legally accessible Huang thesis copy or leave its evidence bound-but-pending; do not fabricate qualification or independent replication.
Only after all D1–D7 criteria truly pass should the KO be reconsidered for documentary verification and later owner release acts.
